displayName.ja: 【新年満喫】 甲河　アスカ

profile.ja: 孤高の抜け対魔忍。忍の名門・甲河家の若き当主であり唯一の生き残り。両親を含め一門をエドウィン・ブラックに殺され、アサギに引き取られて育てられる。14の時には頭角を現し、対魔忍として認められてさくら、紫とともに危険な任務に投入され多くの戦果をあげる。しかし闇の勢力との死闘の中でアサギと対立、命令を無視してエドウィン・ブラックに単身挑むが敗北して両腕両脚を失う重傷を負い、その後出奔する。長らく行方不明であった彼女だが、ある時、両腕に義手＜アンドロイド・アーム＞両脚に義足＜アンドロイド・レッグ＞をした姿で復活を果たし、人魔問わず闇の勢力に加担するものを次々と葬ってゆく事に。今ではアサギと並び、闇の者から“鋼鉄の死神”などと恐れられる存在となる。彼女の両腕の義手には、魔界の医療技術と人の科学技術が融合されたと思われる高度な技術が施されていて生身の腕のように自由自在に、機械アームのようにパワフルで精密に動き、様々な兵器も内蔵されていて、彼女を支える米連系の組織が存在する事が噂されているが定かではない。得物は両義手の中に仕込まれた鎌状の対魔ブレード。米連の関係者と一緒に行動する事が多いとはいえ根本は日本人なアスカ。反動からか正月はウキウキと晴れ着を着て除夜の鐘から初詣、お雑煮やおせちと正月イベントを満喫している。ただ、カルタや羽根突きはその身体能力故に並の人間は巻込まれたらタダではすまない。
profile.en: (Koukawa Asuka, she/her) A lone, reckless Taimanin. She is the young head of the prestigious Koukawa ninja family and its sole survivor. After Edwin Black slaughtered her entire clan, including her parents, she was taken in and raised by Asagi. At fourteen she began to stand out, was recognized as a Taimanin, and was deployed on dangerous missions alongside Sakura and Murasaki, earning many victories. However, during a deadly clash with dark forces she fell into conflict with Asagi, ignored orders, and challenged Edwin Black alone, only to be defeated and suffer grievous injuries that cost her both arms and legs, after which she fled. Long missing, she later reappeared equipped with android arms and legs, and began burying anyone—human or demon—who aided the darkness. Now, alongside Asagi, she is feared by the underworld as the "Steel Reaper." Her prosthetic arms are said to incorporate advanced technology that fuses Demon Realm medical science with human engineering, moving as freely as flesh yet as powerfully and precisely as a mechanical limb, and even housing various weapons. Rumors whisper of a U.S.-linked organization supporting her, though nothing is confirmed. Her weapon is a scythe-shaped anti-demon blade hidden within the prosthetic arms. Though she often works with American contacts, Asuka remains fundamentally Japanese. Perhaps as a reaction to her trauma, she joyfully dons festive attire for New Year, rings the temple bell, visits shrines, and enjoys ozoni and osechi. Yet, because of her extraordinary abilities, ordinary people who get caught up in her games of karuta or feather-tug end up paying a steep price.

text.ja: あけまして、おめでと～♪　どう？　嬉しい？　新年早々、このアスカちゃんに会えたんだから、当然だよね～♪
text.en: Happy New Year! How's that? Happy? Since we met right at the start of the year, it's only natural, right~♪

text.ja: お正月～♪　お正月～♪　正月と言えば、ずばり羽子板よねっ♪　さっ、いくわよ～♪
text.en: New Year's~♪ New Year's~♪ When you think of New Year's, it's got to be the feathered board, right? Come on, let's go~♪

text.ja: お正月の雰囲気って、なんだかいいわよねぇ～♪　よくわからないけど、ウキウキしちゃうな～♪
text.en: The New Year's vibe is somehow nice~♪ I don't really get why, but it makes me all excited~♪

text.ja: 羽子板で負けたら、罰ゲームだからねっ！　真剣勝負じゃないと、つまんないしっ♪
text.en: If you lose at the feathered board, that's a penalty game! If it's not a serious match, it's boring~♪

text.ja: ふふっ♪　どう？　私の晴れ着姿♪　ほらっ、恥ずかしがらないで感想を言いなさいよ～
text.en: Hehe♪ How do you like my formal wear? Come on, don't be shy, tell me what you think~

text.ja: お正月は部屋でダラダラ過ごすのもいいけど、やっぱり外に出て、年中行事をこなさないとっ♪
text.en: Spending New Year's lazing around the room is fine, but you still have to go out and do the yearly events~♪

text.ja: 全く……。罰ゲームにしたって、あれはちょっとやりすぎじゃない？　まぁその……気持ちよかったけど……
text.en: Seriously... even as a penalty game, that was a bit too much, don't you think? Well, um... it felt good though...

text.ja: そ、その……さっきのは、どうかと思うけど……とりあえず、今年もよろしく。お互い、いい年にしましょ♪
text.en: Um... that earlier thing, I think it's... anyway, here's to another great year. Let's make it a good one for both of us~♪
